Print the combined FACTOR LEVELS table into the RG

paste_levels_freq.Rd

Joins the factor level frequencies (`rg_stats`) with the editable level dictionary (`dd_f_levels`) into one table: Label | Frequency | Meaning. The Meaning column is shown only when the labels have been customised away from the raw level codes.

Usage

paste_levels_freq(VNAME, LABEL = "FACTOR LEVELS")

Arguments

VNAME

A character string naming the DGF column to read (the layout passes `"dd_f_levels"`).

LABEL

A character string for the section title. Defaults to `"FACTOR LEVELS"`.

Value

No return value; prints the table to the RG.
